s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Headrest Assembly Center
Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 claws and remove the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.
Remove the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly RH.
Fold the rear seat assembly RH forward.
Remove the 2 rear side bolts and remove the rear seat assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 8 claws and remove the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door opening trim weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Package Tray Trim Panel Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the 2 suspenders from the package tray trim garnish hooks.
Disengage the 2 pins and remove the package tray trim panel assembly.
Remove the rear floor mat rear.
Remove the 2 nuts.
Disengage the guide and remove the deck floor box RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Luggage Hold Belt Striker Assembly (Installation Position Rear Side)

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and the trunk (luggage compartment) hold belt striker.

atten4.ptxt: Remove the LH side using the same procedure.

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 10 claws and remove the deck trim cover rear.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seatback Hinge Sub-assembly (Installation Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and the rear seatback hinge.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Seat Side Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 6 claws and 2 clips.
Remove the rear seat outer belt assembly RH from the guide and remove the rear seat side garnish RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Luggage Hold Belt Striker Assembly (Installation Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and the trunk (luggage compartment) hold belt striker.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Deck Trim Side Panel Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and 4 clips.
Remove the rear seat outer belt assembly RH from the guide and remove the deck trim side panel assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Roof Side Garnish Assembly Inner RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 4 clips and remove the roof side garnish assembly inner RH.

atten4.ptxt: The clips remain on the body side.

s2.ptxt: Remove the clips from the body.
Disconnect the connector.
Remove the bolt and remove the door control receiver.
